objective: GATE 3F-D EDARSAHUB IDEMPOTENCY AND CANARY CONTROL. Auditar exclusivamente si las tablas canónicas de cola de pagos y evidencia de pagos ya proporcionan una protección durable y determinista contra doble ejecución para un futuro canary. No migrar, no alterar esquema, no ejecutar pagos. Determinar constraints, indexes, duplicate guards estructurales y campos disponibles para correlacionar DecisionPagoID, PagoOrigenQueueID, HashOrigen, importe y evidencia ERP.

queries.name: f3d_runtime_identity
queries.sql: SELECT @@SERVERNAME AS server_name,DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS database_user

queries.name: f3d_queue_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity,c.is_computed,dc.definition AS default_definition FROM sys.columns c INNER JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc ON dc.parent_object_id=c.object_id AND dc.parent_column_id=c.column_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Finanzas_CxP_PagosOrigenQueue') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: f3d_queue_indexes
queries.sql: SELECT i.index_id,i.name AS index_name,i.is_unique,i.is_primary_key,i.is_unique_constraint,ic.key_ordinal,c.name AS column_name FROM sys.indexes i LEFT JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id LEFT JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Finanzas_CxP_PagosOrigenQueue') ORDER BY i.index_id,ic.index_column_id

queries.name: f3d_queue_constraints
queries.sql: SELECT o.name AS constraint_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o WHERE o.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Finanzas_CxP_PagosOrigenQueue') AND o.type IN ('PK','UQ','C','F','D') ORDER BY o.type_desc,o.name

queries.name: f3d_pagos_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity,c.is_computed,dc.definition AS default_definition FROM sys.columns c INNER JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc ON dc.parent_object_id=c.object_id AND dc.parent_column_id=c.column_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Finanzas_Pagos') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: f3d_pagos_indexes
queries.sql: SELECT i.index_id,i.name AS index_name,i.is_unique,i.is_primary_key,i.is_unique_constraint,ic.key_ordinal,c.name AS column_name FROM sys.indexes i LEFT JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id LEFT JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Finanzas_Pagos') ORDER BY i.index_id,ic.index_column_id

queries.name: f3d_pagos_constraints
queries.sql: SELECT o.name AS constraint_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o WHERE o.parent_object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Finanzas_Pagos') AND o.type IN ('PK','UQ','C','F','D') ORDER BY o.type_desc,o.name

queries.name: f3d_queue_state_shape
queries.sql: SELECT EstadoEnvio,Activo,COUNT_BIG(*) AS total FROM dbo.Finanzas_CxP_PagosOrigenQueue GROUP BY EstadoEnvio,Activo ORDER BY EstadoEnvio,Activo

queries.name: f3d_queue_duplicate_decision_hash
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS grupos_duplicados FROM (SELECT DecisionPagoID,HashOrigen,COUNT_BIG(*) AS n FROM dbo.Finanzas_CxP_PagosOrigenQueue WHERE Activo=1 GROUP BY DecisionPagoID,HashOrigen HAVING COUNT_BIG(*)>1) q

queries.name: f3d_queue_duplicate_active_hash_amount
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS grupos_duplicados FROM (SELECT HashOrigen,ImporteAPagar,COUNT_BIG(*) AS n FROM dbo.Finanzas_CxP_PagosOrigenQueue WHERE Activo=1 GROUP BY HashOrigen,ImporteAPagar HAVING COUNT_BIG(*)>1) q

queries.name: f3d_pagos_rowcount
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total FROM dbo.Finanzas_Pagos

constraints: NO INSERT UPDATE DELETE MERGE EXEC EXECUTE DDL SELECT INTO OR MULTI-STATEMENT SQL
Do not infer durable idempotency from application checks alone if no unique structural guard exists
Do not propose or execute a migration in this gate
If EDARSAHUB lacks a durable unique idempotency guard, classify CANARY_EXECUTION as BLOCKED_PENDING_IDEMPOTENCY_GUARD
Do not authorize any canary or Payment Executor writer
